$comment: Lint-stage cases (SRS §8.2 step 2, C4, NFR-11). Requirements on any lint MCP server, not on one implementation. `files` are written into the project copy before the server starts (never committed). `matches` are regular expressions (a leading (?i) means case-insensitive). Placeholders: $MARKER_JS (absolute path of a JS file that writes a marker when required), $MARKER_REL (the same file, relative to the project), $MARKER_DIR (its directory).
